title: Video Game Movies Are Having a Big Year
summary:
Many of this year's big movies started as video games. The Super Mario Galaxy Movie brought families to theaters. Iron Lung was a surprise hit with horror fans, and Resident Evil won praise.

Now even more game movies are coming. Reports say A24's Elden Ring film has a $200 million budget. That would make it A24's most expensive film yet. Amazon will stream it. Other game films with planned dates through 2028 include The Legend of Zelda, Sonic the Hedgehog 4, Call of Duty, and a Minecraft sequel.

Netflix is making a live-action PUBG series. Donald Glover will help produce, write, and direct it, and he will star in it too. Sony is working on a film of the game Mouthwashing.

Why now? Hits like Sonic the Hedgehog, A Minecraft Movie, The Last of Us, and Fallout showed that game worlds can bring big audiences. Many new filmmakers also grew up playing games.
why_it_matters: If you play games, you may soon see worlds you know turned into films and shows you can watch with your family.

keywords.explanation: Horror stories and films are made to feel scary and thrilling.
A budget is the amount of money planned for making something, such as a film.
To stream a film is to watch it over the internet instead of in a theater.
A sequel is a film that continues the story of an earlier film.
Live-action means a show or film made with real actors instead of animation.
